# ONLYOFFICE plugin SDK

`plugins.js`, `plugins-ui.js` and `plugins.css` are copied unchanged from the
`sdkjs-plugins/v1/` folder of the `onlyoffice/documentserver:9.4.0.1` image, so
that the plugin works on networks without internet access. They are
